title: Uncalibrated error assessment for five added historical rivers

descriptive_associations.warning: Five purposively selected events are too few for causal inference; correlations are hypothesis-ranking evidence only and are strongly influenced by the Russian River case.

structural_sensitivity.change: Replace the one-cell ribbon with seven-cell idealized lateral shelves.
structural_sensitivity.interpretation: A timing/correlation improvement without a volume recovery supports storage/connectivity as a timing error source and missing forcing as a separate volume error source.

ranked_hypotheses.source: missing intervening runoff and tributary inflow
ranked_hypotheses.evidence: Volume deficit and skill degradation rise sharply with intervening drainage-area growth; the model currently supplies only the upstream hydrograph.
ranked_hypotheses.next_discriminating_test: Supply independently observed tributary hydrographs and rainfall-runoff lateral sources without fitting them to the downstream gauge.

ranked_hypotheses.evidence: The modeled routing lag is too short in 4 of 5 comparable cases; the one-cell ribbon has no lateral floodplain storage. The idealized Russian River shelf removes most routing-lag error and improves correlation while leaving its volume deficit.
ranked_hypotheses.next_discriminating_test: Replace the idealized ribbon with datum-reviewed terrain and topobathymetry, then compare routing lag before changing roughness.

ranked_hypotheses.evidence: Widths are assumed constant and slopes use gage-datum differences, which are not channel-bed profiles; these errors directly alter wave speed and storage.
ranked_hypotheses.next_discriminating_test: Use surveyed sections or conditioned 3DEP/topobathymetry while holding forcing and solver settings fixed.

ranked_hypotheses.evidence: Hydropower, reservoir operations, diversions, and incomplete recession windows can change downstream volume and timing without representing a solver conservation failure.
ranked_hypotheses.next_discriminating_test: Add observed control operations where available and repeat volume accounting over windows that include the full recession.

ranked_hypotheses.evidence: The same solver and grid achieve high skill on Connecticut and Potomac, so numerics alone do not explain the cross-river pattern; they remain a secondary contributor.
ranked_hypotheses.next_discriminating_test: Repeat fixed-forcing cases at multiple longitudinal and lateral resolutions and retain every result as a sensitivity test.
